checks.name: Next mounts the actual shared shell in development and keeps the four role-aware mobile destinations
Theme and backgrounds persist across navigation and reload; switching appearance preserves a form draft
System theme changes update appearance; forced solid and reduced motion override decoration
Compact sidebar tooltips work on hover and focus without clipping; expanded tools remain scrollable
Native dialogs trap keyboard focus, Escape restores focus, and route search remains usable
Native checkbox and segmented controls keep keyboard behavior and do not submit the surrounding form
Mobile date/time fields fit; all backgrounds and shared dialogs work at 375, 390, 430 and tablet widths
Shared text and controls have readable contrast in both themes; screenshots cover phone and desktop
Preference changes still work when browser storage refuses writes
A touch/mobile context can navigate, open appearance, change options and dismiss the native sheet
Actual AppShell still redirects anonymous users to login without a fake authenticated session

limitations: Synthetic UI route; no successful authenticated backend/Firestore integration test
Physical iOS/Safari/Android testing and full feature-page migration remain pending
